notes.title: Patch Notes: SteamDeck support!
notes.content:
Hey dancers!

We released a patch that updates controller support and also supports SteamDeck! You can read the full patch notes below.

Alongside this patch, The Song Editor is now accessible through a dedicated public branch where you can edit and create custom song choreography or create new ones! The branch is called "pcSongEditorIncluded".

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved automatic support for auto-detection and button mapping of more major modern controllers.
[*] Improved button iconography for more major modern controllers.
[*] New support for plugging in a controller during gameplay and hot-swapping, including many related niceties.
[list] [*] Press TAB on the Start Menu or Pause Menu to manually scan for newly plugged-in controllers.
[*] Disconnecting a controller during singleplayer play will automatically pause the game.
[*] Dropping a multiplayer controller during multiplayer play will now return to the controller-mapping screen, as will disconnecting at any point in multiplayer story, so controllers can be reassigned. [/list] [*] SteamDeck support is now added
[/list]
- riv otter

notes.title: The Choreographist - The Game That Almost Was
notes.content:
The newest, latest game by Puuba and Akupara is here!
It's got Rhythm. It's got Action. It's a Fighter. It's... [i][b]The Choreographist[/b][/i]!

[previewyoutube=YCwlw846PjY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][u][b]The What?![/b][/u][/h2]
Crim, a brash and nomadic fiend slayer, has no time for music, dance, or art.
That is, until she offends the wrong necromancer raising the roofs of the undead.

Now, cursed with the insatiable need to dance, Crim and her jubilant goblin partner Gleam will have to use all of their newly found moves to slay their way through the crowds of monsters across the stereophonic lands.

A music-driven rhythm brawler that demands timing, speed, and a clever mind in the heat of battle to slay your enemies before time runs out.

[h2][b][u]Features List[/u][/b][/h2]
[list][*] A thoughtful, combat-driven music game that rewards strategy as much as musical skill
[*] Rearrange enemies on a puzzle-like combat grid, allowing you to create your own high-speed musical solutions
[*] Follow intertwining personal tales into a musical battlefield across a land lost to a groovin' beat
[*] Multiple game play modes, including Story Mode, Freeplay, Roguelike, Pure Music, Puzzles, and even Daily Challenges
[*] Twelve abilities to unlock, with a host of upgrades, special moves, and advanced strategic mechanics
[*] Hand-choreographed songs by a whole Two artists you're sure to know and love
[*] UGC support for music from this game right here![/list]

[h2][b][u]Buuut... It's Totally Incomplete...[/u][/b][/h2]
Alas, The Choreographist was a beautiful idea in search of a beautiful someone to fund it. And didn't.
As such, this game is being released AS-IS and incomplete.

At the moment, the game is gameplay-feature-complete, taking days to beat, and featuring all enemy and (nearly 20!) boss behaviors and all game modes ([b]Story Mode[/b], [b]Freeplay[/b], [b]Roguelike[/b], [b]Pure[/b], [b]Puzzles[/b], [b]Daily[/b]).
[i]However[/i], it only has about 10% of its art complete. Oh, and only three songs to play (placeholding for fifty), despite it being a rhythm game.

On the bright side, there's lots of dev commentary to help you through!

notes.title: Slay The Dance Floor - The Expansion Lands Now!
notes.content:
[i]Grab a Friend and Git Endless![/i]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8ybRDlMHz_4
[h1][b]Expansion Day Is Here!![/b][/h1]
The day has come, and our [i]free[/i] expansion is here! So much new stuff to play and do, let's get right to the things!
[list]
[*][b]Local Multiplayer[/b] support has been added across all game modes!
Story, Freeplay, Sidequests, Arena, Endless, and more..! Every challenge and song has been rebalanced to support two players and has its own separate multiplayer leaderboard.
Some abilities may work slightly different in two-player, and, from what we've seen, different parties thrive!

[*]A [b]Competitive Mode[/b] has been combined into co-op in two-player Freeplay Mode!
Compete for lanes to get most kills, most crits, cures, etc to jocky for MVP trophies. Track your records to school your friends.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/bb19d9d70ef52c2582a2abf0791ff88600886300.png[/img]

[*][b]Endless Mode[/b] is now available!
Unlocked by beating the Story Mode boss, battle against an unlimited playlist of songs as the enemies' levels slowly increase, and a variety of mods get stacked against you.
Use and swap through your entire team and all their skills to combat hero knockouts, equipment breaks, and even skill lockouts.
Gain and spend Battle Points to empower your current run, or save them up to unlock permanent cross-mode rewards.
The faster you go, and the more mods that are applied, the more points you'll get. However! Fail to defeat a song's boss before it ends, and your run is [i]over[/i].
Stack more mods early, while the enemies are weaker, to build up battle points. Or! Run, afraid, from modifiers, to get as deep as you can! Two leaderboards exist!

[*]A [b]new (secret!) hero[/b] has been added to the game.
Equipped with some totally unique attacks and buffs, he's capable of filling a number of party roles.
[i]A Hint to Unlock:[/i] Are there new sidequests around..?

[*]New Hero and Global [b]Passive Abilities[/b] have been added, unlockable through Endless Mode.
Usable in both Story and Endless Modes, we've seen these totally change the best-party meta!

[*]The [b]Scoring System[/b] is now changed!
Enemy kills are now worth points according to the enemy's Max HP. So, the more aggressive you are, the higher your score can go! Bring that RPG strategy to bear!
Just don't die!

[*]A [b]new cheat code[/b] has been added!
Ten-song seeded speed runs! Enter a seed to play a different repeatable playlist each time.
Perfect for another.... WEINER Tournament format..?

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/6eb5bb0822de9352bc024f2a72419ecd7c7a3e9d.png[/img]

[*]Japanese language support has been added.
[*]Lefty-flip guitar note colors are supported.
[*]Support has been added for Logitech G LED colored lighting devices.
[*]Assorted sidequests have been changed or added, as well as rebalanced for two-player.
[*]Story songs beaten after beating the final boss now give additional exp.
[*]Big Pharm's Inspire targetting has been made smarter.
[*]Retribution is now affected by buffs, gear, and elements.
[*]Leech and Slow Field now affect returning enemies, and enemies that have just became focal.
[*]Play-mode triggering cheat codes have been moved to the Teleport Menu, to allow for Single/Multiplayer selection.
[*]Overcast beats are now judged more accurately, in the player's favor.
[*]Consecutive-requirement Secondary Abilities are now more reliable.
[*]Assorted and sundry balance/fixes/tweaks/enhancements to gameplay and menus.
[/list]
Stuff, stuff, stuff is here!

Just boot up the game, and Steam should magically bring you up to date!
[i]The stuff is finally here!!![/i]

ːhugː   ːheartsongː  ːstoneheadː
-Danny

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/43d9d18fc3342acdc74b49c8d034bb552ad82b27.png[/img]

notes.title: New Mode Reveal! Charity Stream For Cancer!
notes.content:
[i]Because cancer is the butts...[/i]

[h1][b]Battle Dance Fiends For Childrens' Cancer![/b][/h1]
You wanted to know more about the [i]Slay The Dance Floor[/i] expansion, and we've got a cool way to give it to you!

Tomorrow only, [b]August 19th[/b], from 9am to 9pm PST, we're going to be running a twelve hour [b]charity stream[/b] for cancer. A variety of Twitch streamers and friends - some of whom you might even know from our Big WIENER Tournament - are going to be streaming and previewing our new mode all day.
Each streamer will have two hours to get as deep into the mode as they can, defeating foes and braving untold mods and curses.

Watch live all day at: http://www.twitch.tv/akuparagames or directly on any of the streamers' channels!
Kick in some cash during the stream, or even now at:
https://tiltify.com/events/the-metronomicon-almost-endless-charity-stream

All cash raised benefits [b]St. Jude Children's Research Hospital[/b].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/f3181f01c1165e72cf3bdef3f5af1fe1cfb6637c.png[/img]

[h1][b]What is Endless Mode?!?[/b][/h1]
Well, I don't want to spoil [i]everything[/i], but Endless Mode is a new end-game format, unlocked by beating story mode!

Move as quickly as you can through a series of challenging songs, killing all the minibosses as you go. Kill the boss, and the song immediately ends, moving to the next.
However! Between each battle, the team will get saddled with a variety of debilitating mods. Skill lockouts, lost heroes, and more.
And so! Use your [i]entire[/i] roster of heroes! Accrue Battle Points which you can spend during the run, to make things easier (or harder)... or save them all up to unlock permanent [b]new hero ability types[/b]!

The faster you go and the more mods you have, the greater the rewards!

[i]Jam to song songs, kick in some cash, and kick a cancer in the butt![/i]

-Danny ːhugː ːheartsongː
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/5dcc795c43005801e39dd86d52b2d270d347130f.png[/img]

notes.title: New Languages! Winter Conventions! Nominations!
notes.content:
[i]New stuff now, and some on the horizon...[/i]

[h1][b]New Languages Playable Now![/b][/h1]
By player demand, The Metronomicon is now additionally available in [b]Russian[/b] and [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]!
For you native speakers, that's... [b]Pу́сский[/b] and [b]Português-Brasil[/b]!
So, you know... if you speak those things (and, erm, also understand me right now...), we have a thing for you!!

Otherwise... play some music and learn you something new!

[h1][b]Conventions! Come See Us In Person![/b][/h1]
It's just about convention season again, and we'll be heading all over the place!

First, in the second week of March, we'll be heading out to Boston, MA for [b][u]PAX East[/u][/b]!!
Despite the flight and hotel needs, this show has become a second home for us, and I couldn't be more stoked to go. Last year, I had a [i]BABY[/i] born while showing this game pre-release at PAX. So, you know... something there will have to beat that!

Then, the [i]very next week[/i], we'll be headed to Austin, TX for [b][u]SXSW[/u][/b]!!!
SXSW Gaming was kind enough to nominate our little musical monstrocity for [url=https://gaming.sxsw.com/news/2017/gamers-voice-nominees-revealed-sxsw-gaming-2017/]The Gamer's Voice Award[/url]!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/9bf77cbc7cdcf3d2618222dc344743eb8024ef9c.png[/img]
It's a voting sort of thang. So, if you're nearby, we want you there. And screaming. Or singing. [i]Loudly[/i].


[h1][b]Mystery Things![/b][/h1]
Before those shows, in the weeks that come, you'll see some announcements of some Super cool new Metronomicon news. All of features, stuff, things, and thangs are in the works, and these conventions will be your first chance to get your hands on Some of it!
[i]Playable Convention Reveals, Ho![/i]

Hope you're all enjoying dancing!!

ːhugː   ːheartsongː
-Danny

notes.title: Dance Battle to the Tune of your Own Music Library!
notes.content:
[i]Big awesome news! Free update news![/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/a5fc87ea6c6524b5f15d3dbc95fc8ebac3e6ad6e.png[/img]

[h1][b]Make Your Own Tunes![/b][/h1]
The Metronomicon’s latest update is here, and it opens up so many fun doors to fun.
As of today, per massive player request, you, the player, can create your very own choreography for your very own music and play it in-game! The very same editing tool that was used to create the game’s tracks by us… You now have that thing.
[i](But, so much prettier! We made it prettier for you!)[/i]

All custom created tracks can be played in both Freeplay Mode and in Story Mode (in a brand new DLC dungeon!) with the party of your choice. Each even has its very own leaderboard, so you can beat your own high scores or even challenge your friends to a dance off!
Learn how to use the Metronomicon Step Editor here: www.puuba.com/metronomiconugc

[h1][b]Also! Stepmania Support! Now![/b][/h1]
Maybe you’d rather use a tool you already know, or keep something you’ve already made.
If you’ve created music choreography tracks before, or just have some hanging around, we are also pleased to announce that The Metronomicon is now compatible with Stepmania’s popular .SM .DWI, and .SSC file formats. Just import your already created files into the game and dance away!
A full tutorial walkthrough for using Stepmania files can be found here: www.puuba.com/stepmaniasupport

Whether you are looking to casually dance to your own songs or push the difficulty barrier as high as it will go, there is now even more choice of how to play with The Metronomicon!
It’s a good time to visit Koras.

Wewt!
Danny

notes.title: Enhancement Patch Today
notes.content:
[i]Well... The first we've mentioned, at least...[/i]

[h1][b]New Features! More Incoming[/b][/h1]
Hey all! You may have noticed that there's been some quiet patches every day or two since launch. Thank you all for your Super Good ideas, suggestions, and bug notes on the forums! We appreciate them more than we can say!

notes.title: Real Fake Guitars! A CUSTOM DANCE PAD!
notes.content:
[i]Cuz fighting battles Should build up a sweat...[/i]

[h1][b]Big And Awesome Plastic Toys!!![/b][/h1]

We've been working hard on getting this working, and I think it's 'bout time to announce something we're [i]really[/i] excited about over here.

[h1]Custom Dance Pads!!![/h1]
Puuba will be working with [url=www.precisiondancepads.com]Precision Dance Pads[/url] to create custom Metronomicon-skinned dance pads! These mats are Super high quality.
Solid, hard backed, glossy high rez printing, and...
Two custom additional buttons, to support shifting lanes in combat!

This is just about the most handsome device that has ever been in my home...

[h1]Also... Big Grown Up Toys!![/h1]
Do you own any big plastic guitars? Rock Band, Guitar Hero, etc?
[i]Those work too!!![/i]
It actually feels shockingly natural, and is quickly becoming one of my favorite ways to play.

You gotta take a peek at some of this stuff in action...
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G54yzioUwW0
So much fun to be had, in so many ways!!
Huzzah!

-Danny

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22417921/2fe23bd2ab1406ccea7fae492cb082fa8e54a932.png[/img]
